subject.title: feat(skill-workshop): add restore action for quarantined proposals and display scan findings

question: Should a quarantined Skill Workshop proposal be allowed to return to editable pending state after a fresh rescan, with Apply disabled until a later revision scans clean?
rationale: The implementation prevents direct application of unsafe content, but the meaning of leaving quarantine is an operator-visible security lifecycle contract that requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve guarded restore
options.body: Treat pending as editable review state, retain the fresh failed scan, and require a clean revision before Apply becomes available.

options.title: Add a separate editable state
options.body: Keep quarantine semantically distinct by introducing another state for editable remediation, accepting broader service, UI, protocol, and documentation work.

options.title: Keep quarantine terminal
options.body: Reject the restore capability and require creation of a new proposal or manual recovery outside the UI.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded restore
recommendation.body: Treat pending as editable review state, retain the fresh failed scan, and require a clean revision before Apply becomes available.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Skill Workshop security-boundary work is the closest available history signal for deciding the quarantine release contract.
